# Backing up workloads on OADP with OpenShift Container Platform {#oadp-rosa-backing-up-and-cleaning-example}

To back up and restore workloads on ROSA,

you can use {{ oadp_short }}. You can create a backup of a workload, restore it from the backup, and verify the restoration. You can also clean up the {{ oadp_short }} Operator, backup storage, and {{ aws_short }} resources when they are no longer needed.
